channel.title: Relay — What's New
channel.description: Illustrative Relay release history. Product concept, not a live service.

item.title: v2.4.0 — Dashboard 2.0 & Advanced Analytics
item.description: Customizable widgets, advanced analytics, Gantt timelines and dark mode. Faster loading, improved search and mobile support. Notification and calendar fixes.

item.title: v2.3.2 — Performance & Polish
item.description: Faster large boards, keyboard focus improvements, notification and date-format fixes.

item.title: v2.3.0 — A more connected workspace
item.description: Threaded comments, mentions, activity digests and improved attachment previews.

item.title: v2.2.0 — Built for your whole team
item.description: Workspace permissions and guest spaces. Breaking change: viewer role renamed Guest.

item.title: v2.1.1 — Small fixes. Better flow.
item.description: Timezone corrections and saved-filter refresh fixes.
